resources.string: The server is taking a while. You can cancel this check and keep editing.

Your server is connected. Your conversations stay on the server.
The changes you typed have not been saved.
Your password and conversations can be read by others on this network. Prefer HTTPS or a private Tailscale network. This choice applies only to this exact address.
A certificate is saved for this address. A changed certificate stops the connection.
Compare this SHA-256 fingerprint with the server owner using another trusted channel. A different certificate will stop the connection.
Connect both devices to the same Tailscale network. Use the computer’s 100.x address or its .ts.net name. Keep the server’s own password: Tailscale does not replace it.
Actions the agent may run in this project without asking. Revoke an action to ask again next time.
The agent will ask before running this action again. A running action is not stopped.
Could not read or change allowed actions. Check the connection and try again.
No always allowed actions in this project. The agent will ask when it needs permission.
Revoked: %1$s. The agent will ask next time.
